cases.title: Image, custom payload encrypted with AES-GCM, 3 LSBs
Audio, custom encrypted payload, 8 LSBs
cases.requirement: Positive audio case at the LSB extreme

cases.title: Capacity check: payload larger than cover
cases.notes: At 1 LSB the long message doesn't fit, at 8 LSBs it does.

cases.title: Image edited after protection (block blacked out)
cases.notes: The payload rows were left alone, so the signature is valid and the media hash catches it.

cases.title: Audio edited after protection (0.5 s made 35% louder)
Forged payload signed with an attacker's key
cases.notes: Attacker key pair generated only for this test, in files/attacker_keys/.

cases.title: Wrong stego key (start location can't be found)
Replay: the same genuine file presented again
Limitation: stego image re-saved as JPEG (quality 95)
cases.notes: verify() said Wrong Start Location: the payload doesn't survive lossy compression.

image.name: Edit outside payload
image.what: Flipped the top bit of 500 bytes that hold no payload
image.reason: Signature is valid, but the media hash doesn't match. The file was modified after it was protected.

image.name: Flip one payload bit
image.what: Changed a single bit inside the hidden payload
image.reason: Signature check failed. The embedded payload was altered, or it was signed by a different key than the public key provided.

image.name: Break length field
image.what: Flipped the top bit of the header's length field
image.reason: Header found but the payload body is missing or truncated.

image.name: Wrong stego key
image.what: Tried to extract with a guessed passphrase
image.reason: No valid header at offset 512916. Either the stego key is wrong (so the derived start location is wrong) or this file has no payload.

image.name: Off-by-one start
image.what: Read the payload one byte after the real start
image.reason: No valid header at offset 493247. Either the stego key is wrong (so the derived start location is wrong) or this file has no payload.

image.name: Crop / trim
image.what: Removed one pixel row, or 100 audio frames
image.reason: No valid header at offset 346990. Either the stego key is wrong (so the derived start location is wrong) or this file has no payload.

image.name: Substitute payload
image.what: Pasted the genuine payload into a different file
image.reason: Signature is valid, but the media hash doesn't match. The file was modified after it was protected.

image.name: Lossy re-encode
image.what: JPEG re-compressed the image, or added LSB noise to the audio
image.reason: No valid header at offset 493246. Either the stego key is wrong (so the derived start location is wrong) or this file has no payload.

image.name: Replay
image.what: Presented the same authentic file a second time
image.reason: Signature and hash are valid, but this exact payload has been verified before. This file may be a replay of an earlier legitimate message. If you are only re-checking a file you already accepted, clear the replay history and verify again.
